Penalties","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Violations and Penalties

FACT_ID: sec13-F01 | anchor: A01
Suspended or revoked drivers win no new license before reinstatement and no legal driving before restoration, and driving through suspension or revocation counts as serious severely punished crime [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-F02 | anchor: A01
Licenses and cards are state-owned legal papers barring misrepresentation and lending, fake credentials feed youth alcohol buys through easy computer forgery, and identity-verification powers cancel credentials for lending or permitting use, altered birth, expiry, sex, height, eye, weight, or card-number data, refused surrender of dead credentials, permitted unlawful use, unauthorized manufacture or plate possession, counterfeit or fictitious possession, forged-name possession, wrong-photo possession, fraud-as-own against commerce or officers, and false-name applications [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-F03 | anchor: A01
Using, carrying, borrowing, or buying fake identification is a felony risking seven prison years plus a ten-thousand-dollar fine, and authorized issuers who knowingly license the unentitled, liars, or picture-swappers commit felonies too [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-F04 | anchor: A02
Some collisions plus any traffic-violation conviction from an Oklahoma court or out-of-state court are placed on your driving record, which Service Oklahoma maintains in full and transfers if you seek a license in another state [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec13-F05 | anchor: A02
Three-year records release under privacy law through licensed operators, the agency website, or mailed requests naming full name, birth date, and license number, cost twenty-five dollars, and run free past age sixty-five [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec13-F06 | anchor: A02
Careless, lawless, substance-troubled, or otherwise unsafe drivers face compliance hearings where the division teaches self-improvement and safer technique, medically limited drivers need division approval under doctor-committee standards, safety courses drill instruction, counseling, defensive technique, trap-spotting, risk-cutting, and attitude, and unimproved drivers lose privileges for everyone's safety [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec13-F07 | anchor: A03
Under-eighteen licenses run probationary on a safe-legal trial with discretionary cancellation or suspension for any moving violation [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec13-F08 | anchor: A03
Convictions mandatorily revoke privileges six months to three years for vehicular manslaughter or negligent homicide, intoxicated driving or control without double-counting same-incident consent revocations, vehicle-aided felonies, death-or-injury hit-and-runs, license or vehicle perjury and false oaths, vehicle-linked drug convictions of any grade, and under-twenty-one measurable-alcohol driving or control [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec13-F09 | anchor: A03
The mandatory point system opens everyone clean, scores one or more points per pointable conviction, suspends at ten points within five years, and allows reductions [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec13-F10 | anchor: A03
Pointable convictions assess four points for reckless driving or failing to stop or stay stopped for a loading or unloading school bus, three points for exceeding the posted speed limit by more than twenty-five miles per hour, two points for restriction violations, careless driving, speeding, following too closely, disobeying a stop sign or traffic signal, failing to yield, or driving left of center or the wrong way on a one-way road, and one point for a defective vehicle or any other violation excluding offenses requiring suspension or revocation [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec13-F11 | anchor: A04
Clean twelve-month stretches erase two points, three clean years zero the total, approved compliance or defensive courses erase two points once per twenty-four months, and totals never drop below zero [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec13-F12 | anchor: A04
Compulsory liability minimums repeat at twenty-five thousand dollars per person, fifty thousand per multi-victim crash, and twenty-five thousand property per accident with proof owed officers, agency representatives, and fellow crash parties on demand, stale addresses risk unknowing suspension, uninsured convictions draw up to two hundred fifty dollars, thirty days in jail, or both plus license and registration suspension, and testing sites span the state with locations posted online [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0072]
